name: Le Terrible
shortDescription: French torpedo-boat destroyer built around raw speed: 43 knots and five guns that reload in 5 seconds, with no smoke screen to hide behind.

consumables.name: Damage Control Party
consumables.flavor: 5s action, 40s cooldown, unlimited charges. Same stock reset the tech-tree French destroyers around this tier get, nothing unique to this hull.

consumables.name: Engine Boost
consumables.flavor: 2 charges, 120s at only +8% speed off a 180s cooldown, about a third of the +20% the tech-tree French destroyers get from the same consumable.

turrets.note: Amidships mount, needs a full broadside, can't reach the bow or stern arc.

torpedoMounts.label: Port
torpedoMounts.note: Fixed to this broadside, mirrored by the starboard mount on the same line.

torpedoMounts.label: Aft
torpedoMounts.note: Farthest aft of the three mounts, can swing to either broadside.

strengths: 43 kt top speed is enormous for tier VI, 6 kts faster than the tech-tree French destroyer at the same tier
Five guns reload in 5 seconds, giving her more DPM than Le Hardi's six guns despite the smaller battery
9 torpedo tubes across three mounts deal 18,400 damage each, some of the hardest-hitting torpedoes at this tier
18,600 hull HP is a big pool for a tier VI destroyer
weaknesses: No Smoke Generator at all, unlike every tech-tree French destroyer around this tier
Engine Boost only adds 8% speed instead of the 20% her tech-tree sisters get from the same consumable
Thin 6-16mm armor and weak AA (four small-caliber mounts) leave her exposed once she's spotted or a carrier finds her
690m turning radius is wide for the tier, hard to juke incoming fire despite the raw speed
8 km torpedo range is short, forces a real approach to land a hit
tips: Use the speed to control range and reposition, not to face-tank. There's no smoke or heal to bail you out once you're seen.
Commit to a torpedo run early. 8 km range means you're already close by the time the fish are in the water.
Kite with the guns rather than trading broadside. The armor won't survive a slugging match with anything that shoots back.
Watch the sky. The AA won't save you if a carrier decides to focus you down.

threats.reason: Weak AA across four small-caliber mounts means plane strikes go mostly unanswered.
No Smoke Generator means there's nowhere to hide once she's lit up.
6-16mm armor turns a return salvo into real damage fast, and there's no escape tool to break contact.

summary: Premium French torpedo-boat destroyer built entirely around speed and gun pressure, no smoke to hide behind.
Reloads five guns in five seconds, real DPM for a tier VI destroyer despite the smaller barrel count.
Nine torpedo tubes across three mounts hit harder than almost anything else at this tier, but the range is short.
Fast enough to dictate range against nearly anything at tier VI, but thin-skinned and exposed once she's found.
playstyle.detail: Le Terrible is one of six Le Fantasque-class contre-torpilleurs, ships the French Navy built less as escorts than as fast strike destroyers, all engine and gun. In game she keeps that identity. 43 knots is enormous for tier VI, and five 139mm guns reloading every five seconds give her real gunline pressure despite carrying one fewer barrel than the tech-tree Le Hardi. What she gives up for that speed is any way to hide once she's found. There's no Smoke Generator in her consumable slots, and her Engine Boost only manages an 8% bump instead of the 20% her tech-tree sisters get. Fighting on her terms means using the legs she has to control range and set up torpedo runs before anyone gets a clean shot at that paper-thin hull.

goalTags.note: 9 tubes across three mounts and 18,400 damage per torpedo, among the heaviest torpedo alpha strikes at tier VI.
